Her passion for photography and love for kids stemmed at a young age as she began taking photos for her mom's daycare. Visit Shefali's blog to read about her recent works.

Slava Blazer is a San Francisco based photographer. He specializes in corporate headshots, event photography, actor and modeling portfolios, family, engagement and maternity portraits, as well as advertising photography.

feeds.title: Michael Shainblum Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at the Photography blog and tutorials by Michael Shainblum. He is a landscape, time-lapse and aerial photographer. Michael first made a name for himself through his unique creativity and the ability to capture scenes and moments in his distinct style of surreal, visual story telling.

feeds.title: Heather Elizabeth Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of San Francisco Bay Area Intimate portrait photographer. I'm Heather Elizabeth and for over a decade, I have been absolutely in love with documenting humans in their most authentic, beautiful light.

feeds.title: Red Eye Collection Blog
feeds.description: I'm Oscar Urizar, the lead photographer at Red Eye Collection, and I love telling stories from my unique, artistic viewpoint. With me as the sole photographer for all San Francisco City Hall weddings, you can trust that your special day is in excellent hands. My style is soft and elegant, and I use natural light whenever possible. I pride myself on being non-intrusive while staging and posing as needed. I adapt to any situation, catch every detail, and know how to fix practically any problem.

feeds.title: Christine Glebov Photography Blog
feeds.description: Christine Glebov is a photographer specializing in weddings, engagement, couple, and family lifestyle photography. She has more than ten years of experience photographing, what she likes to call, 'life happening'. Check out her blog for her photography journal.

feeds.title: Samantha Look Blog
feeds.description: Check out all my favorite images and sessions here and learn more about me and how my sessions work. I'm Samantha, a film photographer specializing in weddings, family and newborn portraits. My goal is to provide you with timeless, romantic images that you are excited to print, frame and look back on for years to come.

feeds.title: Heather Scharf Photography Blog
feeds.description: Heather Scharf Photography blog tells you stories about beautiful family, maternity, wedding, and many other photography sessions. Hi! I'm Heather, a family storyteller. I have been a professional photographer since 2010, but my passion for photography has been alive for as long as I can remember. I love telling the unique and beautiful story that makes up the fabric of each family I meet.

feeds.title: Rosa Delgado Photography Blog
feeds.description: Visit the blog to view the photography work of Rosa Delgado. She is a wedding photographer located in Northern California. She also specializes in family photos and intimate weddings. Creating long lasting photos of people's life is what gives Rosa's life purpose.
